item.title: Economic Daily · October 31, 2026
item.description: The central bank moved its policy anchor from seven days to overnight: from November 2 it will tender 1.25% overnight reverse repos every working day. The same session, 30-year T-bond futures fell 0.94%, the most since March. New trust rules shut the door on guarantees and pooled funds, while the exchange approved RMB 36.6 billion of project bonds for two developers. The price of money is being re-anchored; the channels are being switched. The PBoC re-anchors policy at overnight: 1.25% reverse repos, every working day from November 2

item.title: Economic Daily · October 30, 2026
item.description: No single headline today, just three sets of books: the central bank plugged the month-end funding gap with RMB 1 trillion of overnight money; Shanghai's financing mix moved another 10 points toward bonds and equity; and of 2,862 Shenzhen earnings reports, fewer than half showed growth — optical modules up 200%, chipmaking equipment up 5.10%. Money is still moving, but it is moving through fewer channels. RMB 1 trillion overnight: the PBoC bridges month-end without cutting rates
